title: uncinia longifructus
intro: Uncinia longifructus, commonly known as the New Zealand flax, is a type of flowering plant native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Uncinia longifructus include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
